name: Cook Cattle Farm
tagline: A 7th-generation, 300-acre family farm (est. 1860): naturally raised beef and fresh eggs, plus pork, chicken, lamb and dairy from other local farmers, honey, coffee and more
about: The Cook Cattle Farm has raised cattle in Concord for seven generations. The family works the farm with their in-laws just across the pasture, and partners with other local farms for pork, chicken, lamb, dairy, honey and baked goods. Order online, then pick up at the farm on your scheduled day, or shop the meat store during its hours. Bulk meats too: quarter, half and whole cows, half and whole pigs, and whole lambs (call Hannah to get on the list).
